messages:
Marta R: Heads-up: need final whats-new + changelog bullets for today's docs deploy. I put a rough changelog in PR 982 but need copy + snippet parity check.
Eli T: On it. Which PR is canonical?
Marta R: PR 982 (adaptive routing note, streaming-embeddings deprecation, SDK snippet refresh).
Samir P: I'll update JS and Go. Should we highlight fallback-policy change under Notable changes or only in migration notes?
Marta R: Notable changes 3 lines; migration guide keeps details.
Eli T: Draft whats-new bullets: 
- Adaptive routing improved to cut tail latency and unit cost during bursts.
- Streaming embeddings deprecated 2 migration guide linked.
- SDK snippets refreshed (JS/Python/Go) for retries and function-call examples.
Jules: Known issue one-liner: "Prefix-cache TTL can cause minor score variance on very long sessions spanning rollouts."
Samir P: Pushed JS snippet (PR 985). Streaming->polling example added:
```js
// streaming -> polling
const job = await client.embeddings.create({input: '...', mode: 'batch'});
const out = await client.embeddings.poll(job.id);
```
Jen P: Mirrored Python snippet in PR 990; confirmed client.poll naming. Added Dedicated note: "Dedicated customers: consider conservative fallback thresholds during rollouts."
Avni K: I2ll proof whats-new blurb and produce a one-line marketing blurb for the homepage.
Marta R: Thanks. Remaining: proof (Avni/Eli), confirm snippets across langs (Samir/Jen/Go lead), add known-issue to changelog (Jules), tag internal digest for CS/SRE (Marta). I'll merge after CI and schedule publish for 17:30 PT. :rocket:
